extraction.name: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
extraction.description: A benchmark for evaluating the instruction-following ability of large language models
extraction.creator: Jeffrey Zhou, Tianjian Lu, Swaroop Mishra, Siddhartha Brahma, Sujoy Basu, Yi Luan, Denny Zhou, Le Hou
extraction.citeAs: Instruction-Following Evaluation for Large Language Models
extraction.rai:dataCollection: We created a list of 25 verifiable instructions and constructed around 500 prompts, with each prompt containing one or more verifiable instructions.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: The raw data collection is based on a set of 'verifiable instructions' which are defined as instructions amenable to objective verification of compliance.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: We use a set of prompts with verifiable instructions to evaluate the instruction-following ability of large language models.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, Testing, Validation, Fine Tuning, and Usage Guidelines for evaluating instruction-following ability of large language models.
